summary.description: Two or three plain sentences: what changed upstream for these targets since the tested versions or last week, and whether hopsesh is affected.

breaking.description: True only if at least one finding has severity break.

target.description: The id of the target the finding is about, from intel/manifest.json (claude, codex-cloud).

surface.description: local: an agent's own sessions and CLI. cloud: a vendor cloud.

severity.description: break: hopsesh does the wrong thing with the latest version, or a flag it relies on is gone. risk: plausibly affected, needs a check. info: a new feature hopsesh could support.

evidence.description: What changed upstream and which hopsesh code relies on the old behaviour. Paraphrase; quote at most a short phrase.

source.description: Where the change is documented: a changelog version, release tag, docs page URL, help diff, issue or schema file.

affected.description: Repository paths, with a line number where useful (agents/codex/reader.go:120); for a cloud target, its entry in internal/devtools/driftmanifest/targets.go.

test.description: A test or fixture that would catch this, or an empty string.
